hook: At Fourteen, She Was Handed Over on an Island
text: In May seventeen seventy, a fourteen-year-old archduchess from Vienna came to the river Rhine. On a small island in the middle of the river, the French had built a wooden pavilion, with an Austrian side and a French side. According to later accounts, she was dressed again entirely in French clothes, and said goodbye to most of her Austrian attendants. She walked in as Antoine of Austria. She walked out as the Dauphine of France.
